summary: To avoid one --host call per host, an inventory script can return a top-level _meta.hostvars with all host variables (at least an empty hostvars); scripts replacing static inventory should include all and ungrouped groups.
questions: How do I stop Ansible from calling my inventory script once per host?
What is the _meta key in inventory script output?
What groups must my script output to replace a static inventory file?

answer_card.title: Speed up inventory scripts with _meta
answer_card.answer_md:
Return all host vars in one run:
```json
{"_meta": {"hostvars": {"host001": {"var001": "value"}}}}
```
If `_meta.hostvars` exists (even `{}`), Ansible won't call `--host` per host, a big win for large inventories. To replace a static inventory, include an `all` group (all hosts and groups as children) and an `ungrouped` group.
